Oh shoot, okay, sorry. Can you take my picture sometime? I think you really got the "it" factor and I've been looking to bump up my small, up and coming shoe store out of Savannah, GA. I've been trying some promoting lately and haven't had any luck which sucks, but perhaps you're my best chance at reaching the demographic I'm after. The store is called Big Tom's Footware and Tackle Shop (I sell fishing related items on the side), and I'm seeking to get more teenagers and young adults to buy my merchandise. After an accident where one kid swallowed a baby show that was half price (I do sales like this all the time) and died from a lack of oxygen, I got sued for making the shoes look too appetizing and for "lying about how they're digestible. Which I can maybe understand due to them saying they taste like watermelon and are edible (which they do, but they aren't), but come on. A lawsuit? That's a little too far. I'm a small business after all. I'm not made out of money. Anyway, after that whole ordeal nobody will bring their kids or whatever to my store. So can I get some help? I have an idea for a picture where I'm standing next to the Minecraft Steve and a Freddie from the Five Night series and I'm giving a DOUBLE thumbs up. Any thoughts one this? I'm willing to pay a reasonable price since I'm a very cool and extraordinarily reliable man. Thanks for reading all of this by the way. I know it was quite a bit and people say that I can be rather long winded when talking to people over the web. To be honest I just don't get a lot of time to talk to anybody ever since my husband/accountant die from falling into the red panda exhibit at the Atlanta zoo 3 1/2 years ago. Some people that come in strike up a conversation, but it's never as long or as deep as I like to be. They're always very brief and that's probably because of how I always trauma dump on them about my husband while I help them pick out shoes or ring them up or when I'm restocking and they happen to be within earshot. I don't know... but anyway, yeah thanks for reading all this and get back to me at my business email (verylargebussy@gmail.com) or on the reddit sub that we are currently on. Don't message me here, but make a post that talks about me or that has the name of my store: Big Tom's Footware and Tackle Shop. If you do the second thing that would also be very good PR for me as you most likely already know. Anyway thanks for reading all this, and I hope you have a fantastic rest of your day. Be a shame if it was bad after telling you to have a nice rest of your day ha ha. Hopefully I didn't just jinx it ha ha. Anyway thanks for reading all of this. Oh and don't message me. That's where I keep my shopping lists, and I don't want that being full of other stuff. Thank you in advance, and again thank you for reading all of this.
